name: Sizemasters Technology Limited
about: Sizemasters Technology Limited manufactures and sells thread gauges, plain gauges, multi gauging, taper gauges, spline gauges, and PCD and relation gauges in India and internationally. The company was formerly known as Mewat Zinc Limited and changed its name to Sizemasters Technology Limited in November 2022. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Pune, India.
